attributes.additional_details:
Following the resignation of Keir Starmer, the government should call a general election and allow the British people to decide who they want to lead the country.

The public deserves to be heard. We urge the government to stop ignoring voters and give the electorate the opportunity to have their say on the future direction of the nation.
